metadata.title: Reflections on Stationary Locality with Commander Sol: Private-Place Bridges, Finite Multi-adic Windows, and Formula-Relative Compression
metadata.description: This paper develops a finite multi-place extension of the fixed-ball interior construction in the Prime-Successor Algebra / Two Walls programme. It proves a finite-depth normal form for the additive target with finitely many p-adic integrality predicates, introduces Private-Place Bridges, and derives Formula-Relative Tail Symmetry. Consequences include non-definability of the standard prime order and prime-successor relation and finite Grid-Isolation Rank for each fixed isolator. The Ramanujan labels u_p=(tau(p)^2-p^11)/p^11 satisfy the hypotheses for every finite stationary atlas. The next open boundary is uniformly indexed locality B(ell,x), where the place becomes a first-order variable.
